features: 『 🛡️ 15-Year Warranty Assurance 』: Built for long-lasting durability and dependable performance with extended replacement support.
『 ❤️ Continuous Heart Rate Monitoring 』: Tracks heart rate in real time to help you stay aware of your fitness and health levels throughout the day.
『 🩺 Blood Pressure Tracking Function 』: Monitors vital blood pressure readings anytime to support daily health awareness and routine wellness checks.
『 🏃 Step & Calorie Activity Counter 』: Records daily steps, movement, and calories burned to help you maintain and track your fitness goals effectively.
『 🌙 Sleep Quality Tracking System 』: Analyzes sleep patterns to help you understand rest quality and improve your overall sleep routine.
『 📲 Call & Message Notification Alerts 』: Keeps you updated with incoming calls and messages directly on your wrist without checking your phone.
『 💧 Water-Resistant Daily Wear Design 』: Suitable for workouts, light water exposure, and everyday use for active and convenient lifestyle support.
